description: This file defines a ViewModel class for managing tags within a note-taking app, including data retrieval, insertion, deletion, and association with notes.

classes.name: TagData
classes.description: A data class representing a Tag along with a boolean indicating if it's associated with a particular note.

classes.name: TagsViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing tag data, providing methods to retrieve, insert, delete, and associate tags with notes.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves a Flow of TagData list, optionally filtered by a specific note ID.

methods.name: getSortTagsMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the current sort method for tags, reading from preferences synchronously.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Tag into the repository asynchronously, returning its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple tags asynchronously.

methods.name: addTagToNote
methods.description: Associates a tag with a note in the repository.

methods.name: deleteTagFromNote
methods.description: Removes a tag association from a note.
